intro:
Geography Quiz by GamePix is a puzzle browser game that will put your knowledge of the world to the test. With hundreds of questions and pictures covering a wide range of geography-related topics, from flags and capitals to famous landmarks and world currencies, this game is an ideal choice for anyone looking to learn something new or challenge themselves.

The game's core premise is simple: users are presented with a question or a picture with multiple answer options, and their goal is to choose the correct answer and click on it. The game is designed to be educational, intellectual, and fun, making it suitable for all ages. Whether you're a geography enthusiast, a student looking to improve your knowledge, or simply someone who enjoys trivia games, Geography Quiz is definitely worth checking out.

One of the standout features of Geography Quiz is its vast library of questions and pictures. With new content being added regularly, players will never run out of new challenges to tackle. The game also features a leaderboard, allowing users to compare their high scores and compete with friends and other players.

In terms of controls, Geography Quiz is highly accessible, allowing users to play with their mouse, keyboard, or touch controls, depending on their preferred input method.
